description: This file contains functions for upgrading eMMC storage in OpenWrt, including handling tar and fit images, copying configurations, and performing upgrades.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Handles upgrading eMMC with tar archive images, extracting kernel, root filesystem, and device tree blobs, and writing them to the device.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Handles upgrading eMMC with FIT images, extracting the kernel image and writing it to the device.

methods.name: emmc_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the appropriate eMMC device partition.

methods.name: emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines the image type and calls the appropriate upgrade function.
